svg.title: Surya Prajyesh Eatha. On reading the data, making the call, and automating the rest. MS, Engineering Data Science and AI, University of Houston. Abstract: I am an MS student in Engineering Data Science & AI at the University of Houston. I build machine-learning and LLM systems that turn messy data into decisions: a pipeline that screens more than 10,000 job postings a day, a Formula 1 race predictor built on 74 years of results, and a published UNet model that segments salt bodies in seismic images. My internships span clinic automation, data-visualisation dashboards and front-end work. I am looking for data science, machine learning and AI automation roles.
